I also am an advanced American Sign Language learner and tutor with 8 years experience. I have taught ASL to deaf adults with low language levels and I have taught ASL to hearing adults and children. My lessons include practicing conversational English, enhancing reading skills by means of textbooks suited to your English level, engaging in activities that require listening skills in order to follow directions, and listening to short movie and music clips in order to test and improve comprehension. For American Sign Language, my classes include learning basic, intermediate, and advanced signs, learning and understanding deaf culture, and learning and understanding ASL sentence structure. I look forward to helping you along your road in learning and excelling in your language of choice!
teacher_info.about_me: I love being part of an international community, which means I love talking about a variety of cultural interests. If there's something new I can learn about a culture, I don't hesitate to do so. Other interests include traveling, dancing, music, art, and sea life. I traveled to Belize for six years and to Mexico for two years, so this has had an impact on my focus of interests. A few other things I'm widening my horizons in is construction and landscaping, since I have been volunteering in these two areas for a couple of years. I love talking about children, family, and important values in life. Really, anything you have on your mind is also what I want to talk about!
teacher_info.about_teacher: Teaching has been a passion of mine from a very early age. I love watching people benefit and change for the better due to the education they are receiving. I started helping people benefit from Biblical topics over twenty years ago and until now I have taught other things such as life values, English, and American Sign Language. I obtained my TESOL/TEFL nine years ago to qualify me to professionally teach English as a second language. I have been actively involved in learning and teaching ASL for 15 years.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I cover every topic imaginable, from lifestyles to trucks to computers and so on. I learn from you as much as you learn from me. I cater each lesson to individual needs, such as grammar improvement, pronunciation improvement, reading, and so on. I further break it down into specifics. For example, if you need help with past tense verbs, we will work on this by using example sentences, reading excerpts, or you telling me a story in past tense. Also music, videos, and games...I have it all!
teacher_info.cancel_policy: If you are late for a lesson, I only wait 15 minutes after the class time has started, unless otherwise previously arranged. If you are more than 15 minutes late, I will reschedule the class for another time. If there is a no call/no show after I have made reasonable attempts to contact you for a scheduled class, I follow the three strikes and you are out rule. This means that if I don't hear from you before class that you will be late or unable to attend, or you do not provide an acceptable reason for why you were late or didn't show (such as internet failure) within a day after the lesson time, and this happens three times, I will not reschedule nor refund you after the third time.

pro_course_detail.title: Scenes & Monologues (Theatre Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
Recite a monologue or perform a scene with me and gain acting skills and self-confidence all while improving your English! In this structured class, you'll learn to act, build vocabulary, improve pronunciation and intonation, and work on expressing your character's emotions through your voice, facial expressions, body language, and gestures. No previous performance experience is necessary - all performance levels are welcome! 

📖 NOTE 1: This class requires reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills.

📝 NOTE 2: You will have homework at the end of every lesson. 

🎭 NOTE 3: It usually takes 3 lessons to complete a script, because we will be adding new 
      skills and theatre terminology to the script each time we meet. 

👩🏽‍🏫 NOTE 4: All materials will be provided, however, you're always welcome to bring in your 
      own! If you're interested in this option, please message me in advance, or ask me for 
      details in class.

pro_course_detail.title: Poems & Short Stories (Reading Class)
pro_course_detail.description:

From comedies and dramas to mysteries and true stories, there are lots of writings for us to explore together! This class focuses on developing your reading comprehension and speaking skills, including pronunciation, intonation, and sharing your opinions about the writings. You'll also pick up lots of new vocabulary! 

📖 NOTE 1: This class requires reading, speaking, and listening skills.

📝 NOTE 2: There is no homework in this class. 

⏰ NOTE 3: If we don't finish a poem or short story during one lesson, we can finish it

      discuss your thoughts the next time we meet!

👩🏽‍🏫NOTE 4: All materials will be provided, however, you're always welcome to bring in your 
     own! If you're interested in this option, please message me in advance, or ask for details 
     in class.

pro_course_detail.title: Chatterbox (Conversation Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
A “chatterbox” is a person who talks A LOT. In fact, it may seem like they never STOP talking! 😂 In this new conversation class, we'll chat like friends! Maybe you want to learn American idioms and slang or share photos of a family event or recent vacation. Perhaps you have a YouTube channel and you need help writing or practicing your script. Whatever it is, let's make it FUN AND CASUAL! 

📖 NOTE 1: This class requires speaking and listening skills. Reading and writing may also 
      be incorporated depending on the discussion or activity. 

🚫 NOTE 2: Conversations should be light and casual. Please no inappropriate language 
      or content. 

🍿 NOTE 3: You’re welcome to bring snacks to our lessons!

pro_course_detail.title: Creative Writing (Writing Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you dream of writing romantic poems in English or a science fiction short story? How about a dramatic script with memorable characters? Maybe you have a YouTube channel or a blog and want your content to sound like a native English speaker. If you like to write and want to improve your storytelling skills, then I invite you join me in the Creative Writing class!

📝 HOW IT WORKS:
      1. Write a poem, short story, script, etc. outside of class or during our lesson.
      2. I'll help you make corrections and suggest alternative phrases, sentence structures, 
         and vocabulary to elevate your work!

🤔 NEED SOME IDEAS? 
      When you book this class, you'll get access to the Creative Writing folder in the 
      Classroom Google Drive where you'll discover lots of exciting writing prompts to 
      inspire your imagination, such as music, sound effects, lines of dialogue, and more!

Happy writing; I can't wait to read your work!
